nodes.name: Femtosecond Laser Ablation
nodes.procedure: The Ni/NiO micro/nano structures on the Ni foam were obtained by femtosecond laser direct writing technology with a moveable platform. The laser beam (250 fs, 75 KHz, 1030 nm) from a high-repetition femtosecond laser system (PHAROS, LIGHT CONVERSION, Lithuania) was employed for fabrication. The laser power, scanning spacing, and speed were set at 8 W, 10 μm, and 0.3 m/s, respectively.
nodes.source_text: The Ni/NiO micro/nano structures on the Ni foam were obtained by femtosecond laser direct writing technology... The laser power, scanning spacing, and speed were set at 8 W, 10 μm, and 0.3 m/s, respectively.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of CoFe LDH
nodes.procedure: The electrodeposition of CoFe LDH was accomplished in a three-electrode electrochemical cell (as-prepared Ni/NiO foam, working electrode; Pt foil, counter electrode; saturated calomel electrode, reference electrode). The Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O and FeSO₄·7H₂O were uniformly dissolved in 80 mL water to make up mixed Co(NO₃)₂ (0.15 M) and FeSO₄ (0.15 M) electrolyte, and Ar flow was used to prevent the oxidation of Fe²⁺. A mole ratio of 1:1 for Co:Fe is selected because it shows the best OER performance. The electrodeposition experiments were all carried out at a constant cathodic current density of 10 mA/cm² for 450 s to control the amount and morphology of CoFe LDH on the Ni/NiO foam. The samples were successively named with NCF60, NCF150, NCF300, NCF450, and NCF600, respectively.

nodes.evidence_snippet: After laser ablation, it is clear that the surface of the Ni foam was strongly modified with plenty of micro- and nano-structures (Fig.1 c and d). After 450 s electrodeposition of CoFe LDH (sample named NCF450), the surface of Ni/NiO was uniformly decorated by CoFe LDH nanosheets, as shown in Fig. 1 e and f.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni/NiO shows only Ni²⁺ 2p peaks, surface almost completely oxidized. NCF450 shows reduced Ni²⁺, added Co 2p₃/₂ 781.1 eV and 2p₁/₂ 797.1 eV (Co²⁺), Fe 2p₃/₂ 711.9 eV and 2p₁/₂ 725.5 eV (Fe³⁺), O 1s hydroxide peak.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 3b shows the XPS of Ni 2p peaks of Ni and NiO. It can be seen that only Ni²⁺ 2p peaks of NiO... There is substantially no Ni 2p peak of metal Ni... The high-resolution XPS spectrum of Co 2p shows two main peaks located at 781.1eV and 797.1eV... Fig. 3f shows the XPS peak of Fe 2p, the two main peaks... at 711.9 eV and 725.5 eV.
